verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS payroll platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Gusto offering a self-hostable or on-premises deployment of its core product. The CLI, React SDK, OpenAPI spec and hosted MCP server are clients and developer building blocks for Gusto's hosted service, not a way to run the product yourself, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
